research_notes: The user-defined goal of maximum working time/minimum idle time is best served by reliability-adjusted utilization, not raw per-turn length.
A turn that is two minutes longer but frequently loses its final checkpoint can be worse overall.
Likewise a very conservative turn can waste wall time on handoff gaps.
The staged experiment explicitly measures both sides before choosing the operating point.
This is why production cap promotion is intentionally stricter than exploratory ascent.
Current sample contributes one exploratory target observation once closed.
